summary.en: The "J League 30th Anniversary Match" is currently hitting the National Stadium with Kawasaki Frontale versus FC Tokyo. The Detective Boys were fairly lucky and got chosen by lottery, to participate a special event, have a good time out there by having a mixed special friendly match with players from both teams. They get along pretty well, Ayumi kicks out firstly, and passes the ball to Genta, following by Mitsuhiko, who kicks the ball in the air as he gets it. Then Conan, who gets lifted by two strikers, which heads the goal. Lastly, Kento Tachibanada, a player from the Kawasaki Frontale team, shoots the ball into the goal. Detective Boys gets extremely satisfied, Mitsuhiko then asks Kento what his secret to success is, he answers steadily: "First, relax and calm down." "And, keep a broad field of view. Look at not the pitch, but the entire stadium." Kuryu Matsuki added. Conan sighs and thinks people who compete internationally are on another level. At the same time, within the Metropolitan Police Department, Megure seems to be well-dressed for something. However, when his colleague asks him, he conceals his intent, and utters that it is only some minor business.

locationsDropped: Road near Japan National Stadium Aoyama Gate, Shinjuku
